overview: This enum chooses what allows an attack to continue into its next move.

None.simple: This is the unset transition choice for an attack.
None.technical: EGameAttackTransitionType::None is the constructor default for FGameDataTableRow_Attack::AttackTransitionType. In FilterRequests it shares the hit-gated branch with InputHit, which requires GetFlag159 and bHitTarget before appending buffered requests. In AddRequest it follows the default branch that can resolve auto combos and AttackTransitionKind membership.

InputHit.simple: The next button press continues the combo when the move connects.
InputHit.technical: EGameAttackTransitionType::InputHit appends buffered Requests in FilterRequests when GetFlag159 and bHitTarget are set. The target-only guard can still reject the transition when bTargetOnlyHitAttackTransitionEnabled is true, bChangeLastHitNotTargetEnabled is false, and bHitSecondaryTarget is clear. TCP_040_NormalAttack_1 applies the same conditions for a held NormalAttack_1 input.

InputHitWithoutGuard.simple: The next button press continues the combo when the move lands as damage.
InputHitWithoutGuard.technical: EGameAttackTransitionType::InputHitWithoutGuard uses the InputHit branch and adds a check that rejects the transition when bDealtDamage is false and bGuarded is one. bGuarded is set by OnAttackGuarded overrides, including CP_040 and CN_250.

InputHitWithoutJustGuard.simple: The next button press continues the combo when the move lands as damage against a just guard.
InputHitWithoutJustGuard.technical: EGameAttackTransitionType::InputHitWithoutJustGuard uses the InputHit branch and adds a check that rejects the transition when bDealtDamage is false and bByte1E2 is one. bByte1E2 is the just-guard contact byte set by OnAttackContact overrides and is still named as unresolved in the action header.

Input.simple: The next button press continues the combo without requiring a hit.
Input.technical: EGameAttackTransitionType::Input appends buffered Requests in FilterRequests when GetFlag159 is set. The branch has no bHitTarget, guard, or just-guard tests.

InputTiming.simple: This holds the next input until a separate timing check allows it.
InputTiming.technical: EGameAttackTransitionType::InputTiming appends buffered Requests in FilterRequests and removes all existing AttackRequests keys. FGameCharacterAction_AttackBase::Tick calls ProcessRequests(AttackRequests) only for this type while GetFlag158 is clear.

AutoHit.simple: The combo continues on its own when the move connects.
AutoHit.technical: EGameAttackTransitionType::AutoHit calls AddRequest with the current action type when GetFlag159 and bHitTarget are set and the target-only guard passes. TCP_070_NormalAttack_3 treats this value as the condition under which a held ExtraAttack_1 is not re-requested after a hit.

AutoHitWithoutGuard.simple: The combo continues automatically when the move lands as damage.
AutoHitWithoutGuard.technical: EGameAttackTransitionType::AutoHitWithoutGuard uses the AutoHit branch and adds a check that rejects the follow-up when bDealtDamage is false and bGuarded is one.

AutoHitWithoutJustGuard.simple: The combo continues automatically when the move lands as damage against a just guard.
AutoHitWithoutJustGuard.technical: EGameAttackTransitionType::AutoHitWithoutJustGuard uses the AutoHit branch and adds a check that rejects the follow-up when bDealtDamage is false and bByte1E2 is one.

Auto.simple: The combo continues on its own as the animation and input state allow.
Auto.technical: EGameAttackTransitionType::Auto calls AddRequest with the current action type when the current animation is not playing or GetFlag159 is set. In AddRequest this value is grouped with the automatic types, so existing attack requests are cleared before the follow-up is added.

OnGround.simple: The combo continues once the fighter meets a ground or hovering stop condition.
OnGround.technical: EGameAttackTransitionType::OnGround calls AddRequest with the current action type in FilterRequests when bFlag14 is set. TCP_240_CursedEnergyAttack_1 sets GetFlag159 after one second without a Z change or after a positive ground trace, and its FilterRequests override re-requests the action when Flag159 is set.

Invalid.simple: This is an unusable transition value.
Invalid.technical: EGameAttackTransitionType::Invalid falls through the transition switch in FilterRequests and reaches the default branch in AddRequest, where auto-combo and AttackTransitionKind resolution can still run. The supplied table explanation reports six exported rows with this value.

notes: The enum is a uint8 stored in FGameDataTableRow_Attack::AttackTransitionType and defaults to None in the row constructor.
The InputHit and AutoHit families differ in what can start the follow-up. The Input families append buffered player requests, while the Auto families add the current attack action themselves.
Every hit-gated branch also checks bTargetOnlyHitAttackTransitionEnabled and bChangeLastHitNotTargetEnabled before accepting a transition.
The JustGuard variants depend on bByte1E2, whose field name remains marked unresolved in the reconstructed action header. The description here follows the code path and the enumerator name.
